title: Force account closure succeeded
description: This event occurs when an account is forcefully closed. It contains the result of the force closure operation. When successful, includes account details; when failed, includes error information.

status.title: Operation status
status.description: Status of the force account closure operation.

division_id.title: Division ID
division_id.description: Division ID. This is Pismo-generated ID.

division_code.title: Division code
division_code.description: Code that identifies the division within your organization.

program_id.title: Program ID
program_id.description: Pismo program ID associated with the account.

external_account_id.title: External account ID
external_account_id.description: Client‑provided external account ID used for external system integration

account_status.title: Account status
account_status.description: The resulting account status after the force closure operation.

error_message.title: Error message
error_message.description: Error message describing the failure reason. Present when status is `FAILED`.

error_code.title: Error code
error_code.description: Error code identifying the failure type. Present when status is `FAILED`.
